data.description:
## Context

Before any human go/no-go on a prod swap, the reclaim must be proven end-to-end on a throwaway
shadow clone. This story is the DRY-RUN harness that produces the evidence packet.

## Scope

Run S1 (collapse + ledger reconcile) then S2's swap adapters against a throwaway shadow clone /
fake remote, and produce a measured evidence report: `rebar verify-authorship` clean on the
rewritten graph, reducer-state equality vs the pre-reclaim baseline, and the measured blobless
pack-size before/after with the delta compared to the epic's prediction (~365-380 MiB at N=30d).
This is the artifact escalated to the human for the pre-swap go/no-go.

## Out of scope

Any mutation of the real prod `tickets` remote or the Gerrit box. HARD STOP: the actual prod swap
is a separate, human-authorized step.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The harness runs S1+S2 against a throwaway shadow clone and fake remote with no real-remote access.
- [ ] It asserts `rebar verify-authorship` is clean on the rewritten graph and reducer-state equality holds vs the pre-reclaim baseline.
- [ ] It reports measured blobless pack size before/after and the delta vs the epic's prediction, in a machine-readable evidence packet.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The harness is escalated to a human for the pre-swap go/no-go; no prod swap is executed by this story.

## Portability

Uses only core-git, throwaway local remotes, and the store's S3 seam via a fake-S3 fixture; no dependence on any single CI provider.
data.title: S3: dry-run reclaim harness on a throwaway shadow clone (verify-authorship + measured shrink)
